subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “It also gives insects and birds a place to rest.”?
options: Visitors can go there after reading, but they must stay on the paths.
After reading the report, the city office decided to plant more trees on the west side of the road.
Visitors who bought bird food tickets may use them after 2:30 p.m. or get their money back at the ticket office.
After the activity, the students did not just see trash as dirty things.
